topics.label: WorkSpaces
topics.definition: The Mac-native app for terminal-first AI coding session management.

topics.label: Repository
topics.definition: A tracked local codebase that anchors overviews, terminals, workspaces, and repo-owned web sources.

topics.label: Workspace
topics.definition: An isolated working copy or provider-backed environment created from a repository for a single work stream.

topics.label: Terminal Session
topics.definition: A resumable terminal context attached to a repository or workspace.

topics.label: Surface
topics.definition: The currently selected main content target, such as a repo overview, terminal session, or web source.

topics.label: Provider
topics.definition: A backing runtime that can create isolated workspace environments.

topics.label: Lume
topics.definition: The local macOS VM provider used for WorkSpaces isolation and validation.

topics.label: Ghostty
topics.definition: The embedded terminal engine and integration boundary for terminal rendering, focus, and shortcuts.

topics.label: Evidence
topics.definition: The captured proof used to verify behavior, review risk, and support merge readiness.

topics.label: Performance
topics.definition: The measured startup, interaction, and runtime behavior that keeps WorkSpaces responsive.

topics.label: Mergeability
topics.definition: The standard for changes that are coherent, verified, reviewable, and ready to land.

topics.label: Repo Overview
topics.definition: The repository-level surface for navigation and launch actions before entering a terminal or web view.

topics.label: Web Source
topics.definition: A saved web destination owned globally, by a repository, or by a workspace.

topics.label: Detail Pane
topics.definition: The collapsible right-side supporting pane for files, changes, and selected-context details.

topics.label: Docs Site
topics.definition: The generated static documentation surface for curated WorkSpaces material.

topics.label: Branding
topics.definition: The visual identity, naming, icon, and asset language for WorkSpaces.
